 Introduction 
The Erasmus School of History, Culture and Communication (ESHCC) is looking for two highly motivated PhD candidates to join a research group led by Dr. Natália da Silva Perez examining how European colonial expansion (1600-1900) influenced ideas about women's work. This research project combines archival research and computational text analysis of ideas on gendered labour across different transimperial locales. If selected, you will carry your own PhD research as part of this collaborative research team, and will focus on one of the following historical cases: - Pernambuco - Atlantic Africa (for example, Senegambia, Gold Coast, or Angola) 
 Job description 
Your PhD research will focus on one of the project's historical cases to examine how women's lived experiences conformed to, or diverged from, normative ideas about gendered labour circulating between colonies and European metropoles.

 Coconut Screen Production Worker

 Description 
We are always looking for motivated people who would like to strengthen our team. People who can work independently and/or as part of a team to provide the best possible service to our customers. For a company that produces coconut screens, we are looking for enthusiastic production workers. You will help manufacture and assemble the coconut screens. Are you motivated, do you enjoy working with your hands, and would you like to create a high-quality finished product together with your colleagues? Then we are looking for you! 
 Offers - Market based salary - Weekly payments of your salary - Possibilities for housing and transport (to and from your work) - Guidance by a Job Coach - From €14.99 per hour (excluding surcharges). 
 Responsibilities - Preparing materials for the production of coconut screens - Manufacturing and assembling coconut screens - Cutting and processing various materials to the required size - Working with hand tools and basic production equipment - Checking the quality of the coconut screens - Packing and preparing finished products - Keeping the workplace clean and safe 
 What do we expect from you? - Flexible attitude and strong motivation. - Experience in the technical field is a plus. - Speaking English language. - Speaking Dutch language is a plus. - Driving license is a plus. - You can ride a bike.
